articleTitle: Application of AIGC Technology in Vernacular Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of large language models, artificial intelligence content automatic generation technology has made rapid progress and brought new challenges to the existing design paradigm. The constantly updated AIGC technology will change the future workflow. However, there are few researches on architectural image generation from the existing AIGC technology of architectural design. This study is based on the AIGC artificial intelligence tools such as midjoury and Stable Diffusion and the practice of vernacular architecture. How to use the instructions and methods of style customization and model deep learning to modify and optimize the original concept, so as to explore the potential of AIGC in improving the creativity and quality of architectural design. Through literature research and empirical research methods, this paper summarizes the influence of AIGC deep learning parameters on model training, and then proposes an optimization method for the generation of architectural scheme design process.

articleTitle: Vertex Centric Weighted Edge Index to Accelerate Weighted Graph Traversal
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Indexing is an important technique to optimize graph database performance. However, indexing in existing graph databases focuses mainly on property-value based query, and has not drawn much attention on graph traversal. We propose a new indexing technique, which maintains sorted indexing of vertex and weight values of the vertex's adjacent edges. With this proposed vertex centric adjacent weighted edge index, graph traversal algorithms based on weight values like Dijkstra's algorithm and Prim's algorithm have significant performance gains.

articleTitle: A 146pW, 0.4V, 0.015%/V Line Sensitivity, High PSRR Leakage-Biased CMOS Voltage Reference with the Optimization of Body Parasitic Effects
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper presents a picowatt leakage-biased CMOS voltage reference (CVR) for application in ultra-low-power ultra-low-voltage consumer electronics. The proposed circuit maximally minimizes the interference of supply voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</inf>) disturbance on the reference voltage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{V}_{\mathbf{REF}})$</tex> by optimizing body parasitic effects. To suppress the leakage current susceptible to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{v}_{\mathbf{DD}}$</tex> caused by the parasitic bulk diode and noise in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{v}_{\mathbf{DD}}$</tex> coupled through the parasitic capacitance between N-well and diffusion region, the body of PMOS as an active load is grounded. And the competitive line sensitivity (LS) and power supply rejection ratio (PSRR) can be obtained. With the proposed schemes, the design using a 0.18-µm CMOS process can generate an average reference voltage of 150 mV, while consuming only 146 pW with a minimum supply voltage of 0.4 V at room temperature. It achieves a LS of 0.015 %N from 0.4 V to 1.8 V. The PSRRs at 10 Hz, 100 Hz and 100 kHz are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-96.0\text{dB}, -89\text{dB}$</tex> and -62 dB, respectively. The average temperature coefficient is simulated as 13.06 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{ppm}/^{\circ}\mathbf{C}$</tex> from 0°C to 100°C and the active area is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4752 \mu{\mathrm{m}}^{2}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Research on Open-Source Component Homology Analysis Model Based on Graph Neural Network and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The widespread introduction of open-source components in the software supply chain has led to complex component dependency relationships and numerous security risks. This article proposes an open-source component homology analysis model based on a combination of graph neural networks and attention mechanisms. By transforming the homology analysis problem of components in the software supply chain into the homology analysis problem of component source code. The model first extracts the graph representation of the source code of the open source component, takes the code attribute graph covering more source code semantic and syntactic information as the graph structure feature, and then uses the graph neural network to aggregate the graph structure data of the code attribute graph to obtain the node-level embedding representation of the code attribute graph, and then aggregates the global information contained in each graph node by combining the attention mechanism to obtain the graph embedding representation of the code attribute graph. Finally, the similarity score obtained by graph similarity calculation is used to determine the homology relationship of open source components. Compared with the comparison model, this model has a better ability to analyze the homology of components, and realizes the governance of security risks of open source components from the source.

articleTitle: Residual-Based Convolutional Correlation Analysis for Enhanced Models in SSVEP Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP) systems are considered ideal for practical brain-computer interfaces, with a focus on precise decoding of multi-class datasets in short time. Convolutional Correlation Analysis (Conv-CA) combines convolutional neural networks with canonical correlation analysis, extracting features from electroencephalography signals and template signals in two branches. These features are then classified using a correlation layer. This paper introduces residual connections to the network, proposing the improved Residual-based Convolutional Correlation Analysis (ResConv-CA) model. All experiments were validated on a 40-class public dataset, and considering the 140ms visual delay of SSVEP, we selected an effective data length of [0.64s, 5.64s]. In experiments, the ResConv-CA model showed increased average classification accuracy and improved accuracy for challenging subjects. This confirms the improved stability and accuracy of the enhanced model with the addition of residual connections.

articleTitle: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Based on Sliding Attention Correction LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Time series signals are a common type of data, containing audio data, weather information, electricity consumption, and consumption indices. At the same time, these time series signals are also intertwined with multiple related factors, making it difficult to predict their future trends from a single time series signal. For accurate multivariate time series forecasting, this paper proposes a multivariate prediction model, the Sliding Attention Correction Long Short-Term Memory Network (SAC-LSTM). The model uses LSTM to predict the time series signal, and adopts the sliding attention module to capture the valid information in the relevant variables to correct the predictive results. According to the experimental results, the proposed prediction model in this paper is the best in both of efficiency and effect.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Dimensional Feature Fusion Recognition Method of Micro-Motion Gesture based on Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Current research on millimeter-wave radar gesture recognition mostly focuses on gestures with larger amplitudes, which are difficult to meet the needs of human-computer interaction on the mobile terminal. There are also problems such as the inability to accurately classify gestures with a single feature, and the large amount of model calculations that makes it difficult to apply in practice. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes a micro-motion gesture multi-dimensional feature fusion recognition method based on millimeter wave radar. This paper focuses on smaller finger movements, collects the original signals of 7 micro-motion gesture movements of multiple people, obtains clustered RDI (C-RDI) and RAI (C-RAI) through micro-motion gesture data processing methods. In addition to using a single feature, range, Doppler, and angle features are combined to characterize micro-motion gestures, and a Spiking Neural Network (SNN) with fewer parameters is used to classify micro-motion gestures. Experiments show that the multi-dimensional feature fusion recognition method can achieve a recognition accuracy of 97.6%, which is 11.5% and 3.3% higher than using a single C-RDI or C-RAI feature respectively.

articleTitle: Structural Similarity Filter Pruning of Frequency Domain Edge for Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Filter pruning has become one of the driving forces behind the deployment of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in mobile devices due to its effective compressibility and software and hardware universality. Existing pruning methods are based on analyzing the inherent parameters of the network model in the spatial domain and searching for the redundant parameters present. This approach ignores the correlation of the model structure in the frequency domain. In this paper, filter pruning is performed with the help of discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and edge structure similarity of feature maps to realize the readability of the model structure in the frequency domain. The edge information is an important part of an image. In addition, the WT provides a multi-resolution representation of image edge and can analyze edge at a finer scale. In this paper, the frequency domain transformation of DWT is used to convert the spatial feature map to the frequency domain in order to accurately obtain the edge structural components of the feature map. The structural similarity (SSIM) is also used to calculate the similarity between feature map edges, which in turn prunes the filter based on the feature map importance score. Experiments on two image classification datasets demonstrate the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Path Planning Based on Bidirectional A*-APF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Currently, the traditional A* algorithm faces challenges such as non-optimal path planning, excessive turning points, and prolonged search times. The Artificial Potential Field (APF) method encounters issues like local optima and oscillations. To address these issues, a fusion algorithm named A*-APF is proposed, combining Bidirectional A * and the APF method. Initially, the bidirectional A * algorithm for global path planning is enhanced by incorporating the PathOptimization and IsClear functions. These additions optimize the path by eliminating redundant turning points, shortening path distances, and improving issues present in global path planning. Subsequently, the APF method is refined by introducing discretization step functions, repulsion sensing thresholds, and temporary target points to prevent local optima and oscillations. Ultimately, the two algorithms are integrated, and MATLAB simulation results indicate that the proposed algorithm reduces redundant turning points by an average of around 50%. The algorithm significantly improves search times while ensuring a shortened path distance and safe avoidance of dynamic and static obstacles.

articleTitle: Construction of Programming Knowledge Graph Based on Student Knowledge Needs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Programming is one of the basic skills necessary for information technology talents. At present, from primary and secondary education to university education, great emphasis is placed on cultivating students' programming abilities. Programming learning involves a large amount of knowledge, diverse language types, and is full of difficulties and challenges. How to help students improve their programming abilities and interest in programming during the learning process is crucial. There is a wealth of programming-related knowledge and code, but it is scattered in every corner of the Internet and books, making it difficult to obtain relevant knowledge. It is a good choice to solve the problems existing in programming education by building a programming knowledge graph. There have been some studies related to programming knowledge graphs, but they did not fully consider the actual needs of students. This article builds a programming knowledge graph based on the analysis of students' actual needs. First, student needs were obtained from multiple data sources and an ontology model was constructed. Then we collected a large amount of semi-structured and unstructured data through crawlers and other methods. For unstructured data, We use the BiLSTM+CRF model to efficiently identify programming entities and relationships. We then store all programming entities and relationships in the Neo4j database. Finally, we used the Cypher query language in Neo4j to evaluate the programming knowledge graph, and the results showed that the programming knowledge graph was effective.

articleTitle: Graph Contrastive Learning for Internet Financial Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet financial business, the risk of financial fraud is increasing. How to effectively detect fraud has always been a highly concerned issue. Based on graph contrastive learning (GCL), we propose a fraud detection model called FFD-GCL. For the FFD-GCL model, we design an adaptive graph data augmentation strategy, including topology augmentation based on graph attention mechanism and node attribute augmentation based on feature importance, and use the contrast loss that considers the topology of the network to enhance the applicability of the model for financial transaction networks. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the FFD-GCL model.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction for MOOCs Evaluation Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: User evaluation is an important reference for MOOCs teaching evaluation and recommendation. In the Chinese online context, extracting distinctive feature descriptions for evaluations is relatively straightforward, yet extracting ambiguous evaluation features is equally crucial. Leveraging the syntactic structure features of the comment short texts, the HowNet concept dictionary is employed to augment feature words, thereby constructing a candidate evaluation feature set model. Based on the similarity among feature words within this candidate evaluation feature set, the fuzzy evaluation feature set is derived using the k-means clustering algorithm. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi^{2}$</tex> statistic is employed to weigh the contribution of candidate feature words towards the fuzzy evaluation features, thereby extracting the fuzzy evaluation features from the comments. The experimental results indicate that this method adeptly extracts the fuzzy evaluation features from MOOCs teaching evaluations.

articleTitle: Identification of Important Nodes in the Information Propagation Network Based on the Artificial Intelligence Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This study presents an integrated approach for identifying key nodes in information propagation networks using advanced artificial intelligence methods. We introduce a novel technique that combines the Decision-making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL) method with the Global Structure Model (GSM), creating a synergistic model that effectively captures both local and global influences within a network. This method is applied across various complex networks, such as social, transportation, and communication systems, utilizing the Global Network Influence Dataset (GNID). Our analysis highlights the structural dynamics and resilience of these networks, revealing insights into node connectivity and community formation. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of our AI-based approach in offering a comprehensive understanding of network behavior, contributing significantly to strategic network analysis and optimization.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based Multi-Feature Ambisonics Speech Enhancement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Speech enhancement methods for First order Ambisonics (FOA) signals mainly have focused on multi-channel microphone array-based techniques, without exploring the unique characteristics of Ambisonics signals, which limits the speech quality and intelligibility. The subsequent speech recognition task will thus not benefit. This paper proposes a speech enhancement algorithm for FOA speech signals, which combines various features to achieve better speech enhancement effects. The algorithm extends the Dual-Path Convolution Recurrent Network (DPCRN) to multi-channel scenarios. The sound intensity vector is used as an auxiliary feature to provide the energy distribution information of the speech signal. The phase guidance module is used to provide the spatial information, and the amplitude noise reduction of the omnidirectional microphone channel is provided by the W noise reduction module to provide a clearer back-projection reference. Experimental results based on STOI, WER and PESQ show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the baseline model MIMO-UNet on L3DA<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S$</tex>23 challenge dataset, and ablation studies also demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed features.

articleTitle: Visual Perception-Driven Dynamic Adaptive Shading
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithm that dynamically and adaptively adjusts the rendering shading rate based on pre-rendered low-resolution images. We first pre-render the current frame at low resolution using full shading rate and various low shading rates. Next, we use the difference between low shading rate and full shading rate pixel colors to determine regions where using a low shading rate will not have an impact. At the same time, we obtain the saliency map of the current frame through a simplified visual saliency model. Finally, the saliency map and the pixel color difference map are comprehensively analyzed to generate the shading rate image of the current frame. Our implementation uses computed per-tile shading rates with variable rate shading to lower shading costs. Experimental results show that our method can improve rendering performance with almost no visual quality loss.

articleTitle: Esophageal Image Segmentation with Dual Attention Based on TransUNet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Currently, the diagnosis of esophageal cancer tumors is mainly made by chest based CT scans. Because of the small area of the esophagus in chest-based CT images, it is difficult to determine the tumor region of esophageal cancer using traditional image segmentation networks. So we came up with the idea of combining the traditional U-Net architecture with Transformer. Although integrated variants perform well in many medical segmentation tasks, they lack the ability to take advantage of location and channel features. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a new model for medical image segmentation, called CCA-TransUNet. And we combine the Coordinate Channel Attention(CCA) module and the Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) module into a new module, which we call the Dual Efficient Attention (DEA) module. CCA-TransUNet to Transformer and DEA module integrated into the traditional u-shaped structure, enhance the ability to extract the image position and channel features. By adding CCA modules in each skip connection layer, the network feature extraction capability is greatly enhanced. We have verified the superior performance of our network through numerous experiments on our collected esophageal dataset. We used CAA-TransUNet to perform experiments on our collected dataset, and the average DSC(%) reached 76.44% and the average HD95(mm) reached 3.45.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies for Intelligent Detection of High-Speed Railway Pantograph Network Status Based on Improved YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of high-speed railway technology, ensuring its operational safety has become an important issue. In particular, real-time monitoring of the high-speed railway pantograph network system is of great significance for preventing failures and reducing accidents. This research aims to improve the intelligent detection performance of high-speed railway pantograph network status through the improved YOLO algorithm. Research methods include the use of deep learning technology and image processing technology, focusing on improving the YOLO algorithm to enhance its detection accuracy in complex environments, especially its ability to identify small targets and its adaptability to dynamic environments. It is expected that through these improvements, more accurate and efficient status monitoring of high-speed railway pantographs will be achieved, thereby improving the safe operation level of high-speed railways.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph Modeling and Persistence Supported by Database
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the aviation industry, the spatiotemporal data in the semantic Web is increasing. The concept of spatiotemporal knowledge graph has been popularized. How to represent and manage spatiotemporal knowledge graph efficiently has become an important topic. In traditional knowledge graph modeling research, RDF is usually used to represent and describe the relationships between resource entities. Although the classic RDF model is widely used in traditional knowledge graph modeling, it can only represent static semantics and cannot effectively represent the spatiotemporal semantics of dynamic knowledge graphs. Therefore, in this paper, we extend the classic RDF and propose a new spatiotemporal RDF model, stRDF. On this basis, a storage method of spatiotemporal knowledge graph based on the graph database Neo4j is further proposed. Effectively solves the persistence management of spatiotemporal knowledge graph supported by database.

articleTitle: Design Implementation of FPGA-Based Neural Network Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Currently, convolutional neural networks have achieved significant applications in the field of computer vision, including image classification and object detection. However, many practical applications require low latency and low power consumption during the forward inference stage. To address this issue, we employed a series of optimization strategies such as parameter reordering and multi-channel data transfer to design and implement a convolutional neural network accelerator architecture based on FPGA. Taking the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm as an example, we provide a detailed overview of the process of mapping the convolutional neural network model to FPGA. In-depth analysis and modeling of accelerator performance and resource consumption were conducted, taking into account the actual transmission delay, thereby reducing the error between theoretical and actual accelerator latency. We also made improvements to the input and output modules in the accelerator architecture, effectively increasing the practical utilization of bus bandwidth. The experimental results show that a performance of 30.15 GOP/s is obtained on zynq7020, which is 71.4 times more energy-efficient and 7.3 times more performant compared to AMD5900HX CPUs, and 86 times more energy-efficient and 112.9 times more performant compared to dual-core ARM-A9 CPUs.

articleTitle: Raft Consensus Grouping Mechanism Based on Affinity Propagation Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: An approach to address the shortcomings in the performance of existing consensus algorithms is the proposal of a Raft consensus grouping mechanism, which is based on the nearest neighbor propagation clustering algorithm: AP-Raft. First, the input eigenvalues of the algorithm are gathered from the network transmission efficiency and the current memory usage rate of each node. Second, the nearest neighbor propagation clustering technique groups all nodes based on the feature values. This allows each group's memory consumption rate and node network transmission efficiency to be approximated within a range. Finally, a leader node is chosen for each group, and to efficiently increase the load among the leader nodes, each leader node is connected using a consistent hash technique. Following experimental research, the AP-Raft method successfully increases the system's throughput and consensus time delay while maintaining data consistency when compared to the conventional Raft algorithm.

articleTitle: SPAFuzz: Web Security Fuzz Testing Tool Based on Fuzz Testing and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Fuzzing is one of the most effective methods currently available for detecting web vulnerabilities. However, traditional fuzzing suffers from issues such as low coverage and limited diversity in test cases. To address these issues, we propose a way to generate test cases based on dynamic feature libraries and attack models by analysing the characteristics of SQL and XSS. Additionally, we introduce a genetic algorithm to guide the population's evolution by monitoring the state changes of the web application. Furthermore, we improved the selection phase of the genetic algorithm to optimally deform multiple iterations for use cases with low fitness values in order to preserve the population diversity to expand the attack capability of the test cases and based on this the SPAFuzz fuzzy testing tool was implemented. Experimental results show that SPAFuzz is able to detect more network vulnerabilities than Sqlmap and Powerfuzzer.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multi-Prototype Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Existing representation learning usually neglects two important issues, the intra-class representation diversity and underexploited label utilization, especially the negative feedback during training process. Fortunately, prototype learning, which summarizes the samples commonality, can potentially raise label utilizations and encourage intra-class diversity. In this paper, we investigate the intra-class diversity and effective updates in prototype learning. Specifically, we propose an Adaptive Multi-Prototype Representation Learning, by incorporating the label awareness into both prototype formation and process to improve the representation quality. We separate the prototype updates from the representation optimization and exploit the label indexes to directly implement the prediction feedback. Experiments verify the effectiveness of our label-aware and joint multi-prototype updating strategies.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Artificial Intelligence Large Language Models Based on Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, natural language processing has become a crucial research direction in artificial intelligence. The Transformer model, in particular, has emerged as a foundational model in the field of natural language processing. Transformer and its various variants have significantly improved the performance of many natural language processing tasks. Therefore, this study focuses on the research and application of artificial intelligence large language models based on feature enhancement. Firstly, the paper proposes a pre-trained language model based on the Transformer architecture. Secondly, it analyzes BERT model's pre-training on representing news content to enhance the model's accuracy. Finally, through experimentation, this study demonstrates that the proposed model and algorithm effectively optimize language vocabulary in news, thereby improving its performance in tasks.

articleTitle: A Flow Field Classification Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Flow field classification can help researchers understand flow field characteristics and facilitate flow field research. In this paper, we propose a flow field classification deep learning method based on long short-term memory network named Vortex-LSTM (V-LSTM). This method integrates flow field theory, constructs a new flow field classification criterion, and realizes the classification of complex flow fields in a simple and efficient way. Experimental results prove that V-LSTM can achieve a high classification accuracy while consuming far less time than image classification methods, and can classify flow fields quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Radar HRRP Open Set Target Recognition Based on Supervised Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Open set recognition (OSR) methods can correctly recognize known targets and reject unknown targets. Most existing methods rely on closed set radar high-resolution range profile (HRRP) training, and their ability to reject unknown targets is limited. However, methods that reject unknown targets may be more practical. This paper proposes an open set radar HRRP target recognition method. The proposed method creatively uses a ConvNeXt encoder based on contrast learning to improve the interclass distance of target features and designs an unknown class target detector to improve the intraclass distance of features. Specifically, the method comprises three components: the ConvNeXt encoder, the known target classifier, and the unknown target detector. ConvNeXt is used as an encoder and trained following a supervised contrast learning strategy to make the embedding features tighter for samples of the same class and sparser for samples of different classes. The known target classifier uses a closed set identification training method to achieve known target classification. The unknown target detector is trained using MSE as a loss function, resulting in tighter embedded features for the same type of samples. The test sample queries the class center using the recognition results of the known target classifier and then distinguishes whether it is a known or unknown target based on the distance of the test sample from the class center. Experimental results show that the proposed method has excellent open set recognition performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Two-Stage Method for Texture Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Texture defect detection has wide applications in both textiles and industry, where traditional defect detection methods focus on costly manual labeling and defect samples are complex to collect in real-world industrial scenarios. Furthermore, labeling errors are common in datasets from industrial scenarios, and the problem still needs to be explored. Therefore, we propose a novel texture defect detection method. It has two stages; the defective samples are synthesized in the first stage. In the second stage, we represent normal samples using a self-supervised learning method. Then, we construct a single classifier based on this learned representation. Subsequently, the model is trained to distinguish between normal and defective samples within the embedding space. To increase the robustness of our method, we adopt a novel strategy to construct defective samples and compute the feature similarity through a similarity-weighted aggregation method to achieve defect detection, which is more robust to noise. Experimental results on the DAGM2007 dataset show that our method performs comparably to the leading texture defect detection methods without label noise. In contrast, in the presence of noise, our method can effectively minimize the impact of noise on model performance.

articleTitle: Motion Retargeting from Human in Video to 3D Characters with Different Skeleton Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Motion retargeting from videos to 3D virtual character is a challenging task in computer vision and computer graphics. A solution is first to extract the 3D motion sequences from videos using human pose estimation algorithm and then retarget to 3D virtual character by skeleton motion retargeting algorithm. However, manual skeleton mapping is often necessary because of the difference in skeleton topology between pose estimation and 3D virtual character, introducing uncertainty and potentially compromising the semantics of the original motion. Additionally, the results of pose estimation contain noise while existing skeleton motion retargeting algorithms do not consider the influence of noise inputs in their design. In response to the above issues, we propose a novel motion retargeting framework and introduce a new motion retargeting network named CTBRnet (Combined Transformer Bi-LSTM Retargeting network). The framework leverages existing algorithm to generate paired training data, providing supervision to CTBRnet and enabling CTBRnet to learn potential skeleton mapping. The framework utilizes human motion videos as input and generates retargeting results for virtual characters, which are driven by joint rotations aligned with the virtual character's skeletal topology. Our proposed network combines transformer and Bi-LSTM, effectively capturing stable high-dimensional motion features from noisy results of pose estimation in both global and local perspectives. The experimental results show that our framework can achieve motion retargeting from videos to 3D virtual character with different skeleton topology, and compared with existing skeleton motion retargeting networks, CTBRnet reduces joint position errors while enhancing the smoothness.

articleTitle: Multiple Sequence Alignment Based on Indicator-Based Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In this paper, multiple sequence alignment (MSA) is modeled as a two-objective minimization problem, the score of the alignment serves as an objective, the penalty of the gaps serves as the other objective. Three scoring methods are compared to test the effectiveness of the proposed model. Indicator-based evolutionary algorithm (IEA) is used to resolve MSA. The experimental results of 12 state-of-the art aligners are compared with those of the model proposed. The results show that, MSA-IEA achieves uniformly distributed Pareto optimal front. Among the three scoring methods, the linear combination of Q-score, total column score and weighted sum of pair performs the best in the exploration and convergence of the algorithm. The results convey that, more effort should be focused on the design of the scoring method in the MSA based on multi-objective evolutionary algorithm, so that the subjective and the objective scoring criteria can precisely guide the population towards the Pareto optimal front.

articleTitle: EEG Based Autism Recognition Model: EEGCM-Net Based Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Autism spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder whose diagnosis currently relies primarily on assessment and diagnosis by experienced clinicians. In this study, we used electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and EEGCM-Net model to detect ASD. EEGCM-Net first realized adaptive weight allocation to different EEG channels through channel attention mechanism, and then extracted time-frequency features by one-dimensional convolution. Subsequently, the multi-head attention mechanism is introduced to focus on the spatio-temporal relationship between different time Windows and channels to better capture signals and generate more discriminative features. In this study, two different experimental paradigms were tested on the ABC-CT public data set, and both were targeted at the same subjects. The experimental results show that the average classification accuracy of the proposed method is 91% and 92% under the two paradigms. Sensitivity is 98%, 99.5%; F1-score was 93.9% and 94.7%; The AUC was 97%,96.3%. These indicators indicate that the method can automatically extract and classify the features of EEG signals, so as to effectively detect ASD.

articleTitle: YOLOv5 Algorithm Optimization: Precise Target Detection Amidst Background Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper solves the challenge that the target is submerged in the background in the border security scenario, and proposes the enhancement of YOLOv5 algorithm. EfficientViT replaces the DarkNet backbone, leveraging Transformer models for improved feature extraction. Modifications to the Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast (SPPF) module enhance the algorithm's robustness to scale variations. Introducing SCYLLA-IoU (SIoU) in the loss function improves model convergence speed and accuracy. Validated on a custom border security dataset, the enhancements show an improved average precision mean (mAP) of 48.3%, a 2.2 percentage point increase over the original YOLOv5s model.

articleTitle: Automatic White Balance Using ShuffleNet-v1 and Adaptive Histogram Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to enhance the automatic white balance (A WB) efficiency and performance, a ShuffleNet-vl classifier is trained using the color-distorted dataset, which is constructed by histogram shifting from Pascal VOC. Image identified as normal by this classifier is output directly, while the classified distorted image is processed by histogram matching with flexible reference channel, in which the reference channel is adaptively selected according to the mean gray level of the maximal channel. Experiments show that the best deployment parameter is achieved by ShuffleNet-vl, which is 156.20% larger than the second best that achieved by MobileN et-v2. In addition, the overlap area is maximized and the visual effect is improved by adaptive histogram matching.

articleTitle: A Method of EEG Source Imaging Based on TCN and Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has shown great potential in the field of brain-computer interfaces, especially Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, which have achieved good performance in EEG source imaging. In this paper, we propose a method based on Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) for EEG source imaging, with the introduction of multi-head attention mechanism in the network. Compared to traditional TCN networks, we utilize a variant of TCN that can effectively extract temporal information by simultaneously considering past and future information. The multi-head self-attention mechanism enables the model to allocate attention weights more reasonably and improves the model's expressive power. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method performs well in EEG source imaging.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring System Design of IoT-based Multi-Physiological Parameters with STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: An IoT-based multi-physiological parameters monitoring system for home health care is designed to effectively monitor the health status and prevent cardiovascular diseases. The system is based on the STM32FI03C8T6 microcontroller, which controls the real-time collection of signals such as pulse, blood oxygen level, heart rate, body temperature, and electrocardiogram (ECG) using the MAX30102, MLX90614, and AD8232 acquisition modules. The system can monitor multiple physiological parameters of people in real-time and transmit the data to the PC for data analysis and processing using MATLAB. Then, the processed data can be visualized using LABVIEW or display the data on a mobile phone via Bluetooth. In addition, the results can also be transmitted to a cloud platform via WiFi so as to assess and provide more professional advice for health care experts.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Based on Lightweight Improvement YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large amount of parameters, high computation of floating point calculations and large model volume when YOLOX model is applied to pedestrian detection, a lightweight improvement based on YOLOX is proposed. Firstly, the SA-Ghost2 module is proposed to replace the module used for feature extraction in the backbone network, compressed model volume and reduced computation. Secondly, add a CBR operator fusion block at the bottom of dark layer, the expressive ability and overall performance of the model is improved without adding extra computation. Finally, the original Loss function is improved to Focal Loss to accelerate model convergence and improve accuracy. The experimental results show that, compared with the original model, the amount of parameters, floating point operations and the model volume of the improved model are reduced by 32%, 17.4% and 31.4% respectively, and the experimental effect of mAP _ 0.5 on CityPersons dataset is increased by 1.4 percentage points.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Consumer Electronics Sales Based on GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: To grasp the development trend of consumer electronics, this article establishes a neural network prediction model optimized by a genetic algorithm based on a traditional BP neural network, and predicts the sales volume of consumer electronics. This article first conducts correlation analysis to select 5 parameters that are closely related to the predicted variables. Then, the BP neural network model and GA-BP neural network model are respectively used to predict the sales of consumer electronics. Finally, the prediction results and accuracy of the two models are analyzed for errors. The example proves that the GA-BP neural network prediction model has good prediction performance, improves the prediction accuracy of the network model, and achieves a more accurate prediction of consumer electronics sales.

articleTitle: Application of Improved A* Algorithm in Game Pathfinding
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Pathfinding is a very important element in game development. A* algorithm is widely used in game pathfinding, and is one of the more popular heuristic search algorithms. In order to realize the application of the algorithm in different game map scenes and improve the execution efficiency of the A* algorithm, this paper presents an improved A* algorithm. Multiple nodes with the lowest evaluation value in the open list are reprocessed, the node with the lowest h(n) is selected as the nodeto be processed, and the node in the close list is reutilized. At the same time, a new heuristic function is constructed for the map environment. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm can effectively find the shortest path in the game map, shorten the time consumption of path finding, and improve the playability of the game.

articleTitle: DLKNet: Dual Large Kernel Network for Real-Time Semantic Segmentation With Transformer Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The dual-resolution network architecture has proven its effectiveness in real-time semantic segmentation. In recent years, transformer-based networks have achieved great success in visual tasks, prompting researchers to explore how to better transplant the transformer architecture to semantic segmentation. However, due to the relatively high computational cost compared to Convolutional Neural Network based (CNN-based) models, it has been a challenge to apply in real-time semantic segmentation. Fortunately, previous works have shown that using CNN-based models alone can achieve comparable performance to networks using the transformer architecture. In this paper, we build upon the dual-resolution structure of DDRNet and optimize the network further. We propose the LKBlock, which is a transformer-like large kernel block constructed using depthwise separable convolution structures. We use a simple fusion module for merging between different resolution branches and design an auxiliary head for enhancing edge information learning. Through experiments on Cityscapes, our method achieved an mIo U of 76.9% and an inference speed of 103.7FPS, demonstrating the effectiveness of this structure and achieve a better balance between performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Urine Routine Tests-Based Machine Learning and Urinalysis to Predict Acute Kidney Injury: URT-Based Machine Learning and Urinalysis to Predict AKI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) is a heterogeneous disease characterized by an increase in serum creatinine (Scr) or a decrease in urine output. It is a common critical illness with high morbidity, mortality, and clinical adverse events. In this study, we investigated the links that exist between data factors as well as target category features in urine routine tests (URT). Ten different machine learning algorithms were used to construct a classification prediction model for acute kidney injury, which can determine whether a patient suffers from acute kidney injury based on the patient's current physiological indicators. The dataset had a total of 33279 data (age <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$49\pm 24$</tex> years, 48% women, 8914 AKI events) and 7 categories of features. Ten machine learning-based classifiers were trained and tested in a supervised learning environment. The maximum performance metric model has an accuracy of 0.934, precision of 0.93, recall of 0.90, and F1 score of 0.91. The experiments were tested for multi-algorithm comparisons, providing decision-making support on which algorithms need to be selected when studying such problems in the field of AKI prediction.

articleTitle: Staged Coal Leakage Detection Method Based on Improved Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Coal mill plays a crucial role in thermal power plants, however, operational issues such as coal leakage can lead to coal accumulation, adversely affecting equipment performance and resulting in energy wastage. The challenging operational environment of coal mills, characterized by dim lighting, dust interference, and other factors, poses difficulties for coal leakage detection. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a staged coal leakage detection method based on improved YOLOv5s and improved MobileNetV3-Small. The method operates in two stages: firstly, YOLOv5s is employed to identify areas prone to coal accumulation, and secondly, MobileNetV3-Small is utilized to confirm the presence of coal accumulation in these areas. In addition, the coordinate attention mechanism is introduced to both network, which enhances the attention of the network with fewer parameters. This approach effectively enhances detection accuracy with minimal computing cost by leveraging two improved networks. Experimental results demonstrate an impressive accuracy of 93.7% in detecting coal accumulation phenomena. Moreover, the entire process is executed within 0.039 seconds, meeting the requirements for real-time detection.

articleTitle: Integral Structure Parameters of CAD Model Based on Vectorial Finite Element Discrete Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient and stable vector-form finite element discrete analysis grid method, which can directly input the grid management with external characteristics for complex three-dimensional graphics. The experimental results show that the proposed deep learning algorithm can greatly improve the quality of mesh generation while maintaining the external characteristics of the shape and size of natural language. It reduces the quality of the area where the extra target surface is located and increases the movement speed of the model. The problem that the edge of the mesh extra target surface is turned over is solved, so that the topological relation of the mesh extra target surface layer by layer is more regular. The mesh is thus greatly improved.

articleTitle: An Efficient CNN Model for Outdoor Hazard Sound Classification with Hearing-Impaired Accessibility
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With urbanization reshaping the auditory landscape of cities, the significance of discerning hazardous sounds in outdoor environments has become paramount, especially for the hearing-impaired community. This paper introduces an efficient Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model tailored for the classification of outdoor hazard sounds to enhance the safety of individuals with hearing impairments. Our model transforms audio signals into spectrogram images, leveraging the power of image classification techniques. Through rigorous training and optimization, the model achieves an accuracy exceeding 90% on diverse sound categories. A comparative analysis with existing works further underscores its superior performance. By bridging technological advancements with a commitment to accessibility, this research not only showcases the potential of machine learning but also emphasizes the importance of inclusivity in innovation.

articleTitle: A Conditional Diffusion Model for 3D Human Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Monocular 3D human pose estimation is a highly challenging task due to inherent depth ambiguity and occlusion. In response to these challenges, many previous works have utilized temporal information to enhance the richness of information. However, such methods can only derive a specific 3D pose from a single image, which fails to address ambiguity. Fortunately, denoising diffusion probabilistic models have recently achieved success in various computer vision tasks (e.g., generating images and image segmentation). Diffusion-based methods produce a set of possible result for each image. Inspired by this, we explore a novel Conditional Diffusion-based 3D human Pose estimation framework (CDiffPose) that formulates 3D human pose estimation as a 2D keypoints-guided 3D pose synthesis problem. We utilize a pre-trained model to represent 2D keypoints information as conditioning information. Subsequently, we inject the conditional information into the denoising model. Our denoising model (Denoiser) adopts a cascaded approach involving GCN and Transformers. Finally, the model generates multiple 3D candidates poses for a single 2D keypoint to alleviate the inherent depth ambiguity. Extensive experiments are conducted on Human3.6M benchmark, our proposed method demonstrates competitive performance.

articleTitle: Calibrating Car-Following Models on Scenarioized Data using GA-NM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: As the core content of microscopic traffic flow theory, the car-following model links human microscopic driving behavior with macroscopic traffic phenomena, which is widely used in traffic simulation and traffic safety evaluation. In our opinion, calibrating these models to real-world data is crucial. Previous works mainly focused on the calibration of car-following models on special scenarios or coarse-grained scenarios. In this paper, we employ K-means for the fine-grained mining of vehicle-following scenarios, and we apply a novel hybrid optimization algorithm GA-NM to calibrate the parameters of the car following model in four car following scenarios. The experiment results show that the GA-NM algorithm consistently outperforms the original GA algorithm, and FVD model has the lowest and most stable calibration errors, which are suited for Chinese highway simulations.

articleTitle: Multi-Behavioral Recommender System with Heterogeneous Graph Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of online platforms and the explosive growth of user-generated data, personalized recommendation systems have become increasingly crucial in delivering relevant content to users. Traditional recommendation approaches often focus on modeling user-item interactions, neglecting the rich contextual information associated with user behaviors. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-behavior recommendation system based on heterogeneous graph learning. By leveraging the power of heterogeneity, our model integrates various types of user behaviors, such as browsing, adding cart, and purchasing, into a unified framework. We design a graph-based representation for capturing the complex relationships between users, items, and behaviors. Additionally, we introduce a graph neural network approach to effectively propagate and aggregate information across the heterogeneous graph. Experimental results on a real-world dataset demonstrate that our proposed system outperforms state-of-the-art recommendation methods in terms of accuracy and diversity. The findings highlight the potential of heterogeneous graph learning in enhancing the performance of multi-behavior recommendation systems.

articleTitle: A Method for Deblurring Estimation From a Single Image
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenging problem of removing blurred regions from a single image. We propose a simple yet effective method for estimating the spatial variation of defocus blur at edge positions. The input defocused image is re-blurred using a Gaussian kernel, and the defocus blur amount is obtained by the ratio of gradients between the input image and the re-blurred image. By propagating the blur amount at edge positions to the entire image, we obtain a fully defocused image representing the depth of the scene. We further investigate deblurring methods for images with different degrees of blur, and ultimately achieve deblurring effects for various degrees of blur through parameter dynamicization. Experimental results on real images demonstrate a reliable defocus estimation method for removing blurred regions from images.

articleTitle: Weak Ship Target Detection Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Based on the problems of ship target detection difficulty and small target under the complex sea and sky background at sea, and the poor algorithm boundary regression effect and inaccurate detection caused by the inconsistency between the target size of the dataset and the anchor frame, a ship target detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv5 is proposed. By changing the non-local feature attention and spatial channel attention algorithms, the network can effectively extract the depth information and the position of interest of the object, and the anchor frame algorithm is improved, which makes the anchor frame more compatible with the ship target and improves the average detection accuracy of the algorithm. Average detection accuracy. The results of the ablation experiment show that the average detection accuracy of the improved algorithm is 1.1% higher than that of the standard YOLOv5 algorithm. The results of ablation experiments show that the average detection accuracy of the improved algorithm is 1.1% higher than that of the standard YOLOv5 algorithm, and the results of comparison experiments show that the improved algorithm has a higher average detection accuracy than that of the other improved algorithms. Comparison experiments show that the improved algorithm has higher average detection accuracy than other improved YOLOv5 algorithms, which verifies the superiority of the improved algorithm in the paper and improves the detection effect of weak ship targets. The results show that the improved algorithm has higher average detection accuracy compared with other improved YOLOv5 algorithms.

articleTitle: A Big Data-Driven Unsupervised Indoor and Outdoor Detection Approach Using Deep Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This With the rapid development of mobile internet, people's lives have become more convenient, such as taking taxis with phones and so on. In the process of people enjoying convenience, user needs have evolved from basic positioning ability to perception ability. IOD (Indoor and outdoor detection), as an important perception ability, has been studied by many scholars in academia and industry. However, there are still many problems such as difficulty in obtaining supervision information and poor model robustness. In this work, we propose an unsupervised label generation approach that obtains IOD labels by mining massive localization logs, effectively solving the problem of expensive manual labelling for IOD labels. In addition, we propose a deep contrastive learning based indoor and outdoor detection network, called CLIODNet, which fully enhances the robustness and correctness of model detection. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments in four real environments. The experimental results show that our model has greatly improved compared to the baseline.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Multi-Graph Attention Fusion Network for Tag Information-Enhanced Social Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Tag information has gained substantial attention in the realm of social recommendation due to its potential in capturing user preferences. However, existing recommendation methods usually overlook the inherent heterogeneity introduced by the tag information, resulting in a failure to fully exploit the heterogeneous relationships among users, items, and tags. In this paper, a tag information enhanced social recommendation method based on the heterogeneous multi-graph attention fusion network (HMAF) is proposed to recommend items for target users. Firstly, the user-item-tag heterogeneous graph is constructed to model the relationships between users, items and tags, and then the heterogeneous graph is subsequently partitioned into three bipartite graphs: the user-item bipartite graph, the user-tag bipartite graph, and the item-tag bipartite graph. Secondly, the multi-graph propagation network is developed to learn the features of users, items and tags on the three bipartite graphs. Thirdly, the multi-graph attention fusion network is developed to fuse the features of users and items from the three bipartite graphs, respectively. Extensive experiments were conducted on the Last. Fm dataset to evaluate the performance of HMAF, and the experimental results demonstrated the superiority of HMAF compared to the baselines.

articleTitle: Research on Paper-Pen Interaction Methods and Implementation of Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This article examines paper-pen interaction methods and develops a real-time software for mobile devices that mimics handwriting. It includes features like paper texture rendering, stroke thickness control, and ink diffusion. The software adapts stroke width control based on pen pressure or velocity for realistic handwriting in different scenarios. Smooth writing effects are achieved through second-order Bezier curves. The paper's texture and roughness are simulated using the Perlin Noise algorithm. A simplified two-dimensional surface efficiency model of the article is created. This allows different types of paper to be displayed together with regulated ink dispersal according to the properties of the paper and ink.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Decision-Making Support in Real-Time Strategy Game
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Real-Time Strategy (RTS) games have attracted millions of players due to their characteristics of diverse scenes and flexible decision-making mechanisms. However, the mechanisms, contents, and operations of RTS games could be quite complex for beginners. The frustration and poor beginner experience caused by the high level of difficulty in getting started may lead novice players to give up on a specific RTS game due to a lack of sense of achievement. To address this issue and enhance the gaming experiences of beginners, this article proposes to assist beginners in familiarizing themselves with the mechanisms of the games and evaluating the opponents' abilities based on ontology. Firstly, an ontology will be built according to the properties of game units, which can provide beginners with a clear and comprehensive conceptual framework to understand game mechanisms and operations. Secondly, a knowledge-based reasoning method will be proposed to help beginners evaluate their opponents' abilities. Using a specific RTS game as a demonstration, the ontology is built and a reasoning example is proposed. By analyzing and reasoning about the abilities of their opponents' game units, this reasoning method can help beginners develop more effective strategies and tactics to enhance their experience in the game.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Frequency Modular Distribution of Steady-State Visual Evoked Stimuli and Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, visual stimulation has received high attention in the research of brain-computer interface and human-computer interaction. Since SSVEP is not easily affected by human factors such as blinking and eye movement and myoelectric noise interference, it has been widely used in brain-computer interface system engineering. How to encode more visual stimuli with limited frequency and achieve BCI with high accuracy and transmission rate is the main problem in SSVEP-based brain computer interface system. In this study, I used a multi-frequency coding method with time and frequency interleaving to modularize the distribution of stimuli with similar frequencies to induce SSVEP signals in a shorter period of time, encode more stimulus modules with a small number of frequencies, and use canonical correlation analysis to explore the correlation between the original data and the comparison frequency, so as to produce command output with high accuracy. At present, the four-instruction coding based on double frequency has reached 94.50±3.50% accuracy in controlling the moving direction of the machine car, and the three-frequency coding 27-instruction letter speller can reach high accuracy.

articleTitle: Increase the Efficiency of Deploying Application Instances in Edge Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: To enhance the efficiency of deploying application instances on edge servers, this paper proposes a greedy algorithm (KEAD-P) that utilizes prioritized queues (heap). The algorithm initially generates an index of the available servers and an empty list to store the selected servers. It then calculates the coverage benefit of each available server, which in turn determines the ACRB (Coverage-Robustness Increase Benefit) of each server. Based on the results of the calculation, the algorithm constructs a priority queue (heap) that prioritizes the servers with the highest ACRB. Finally, the algorithm selects servers by continuously cycling until the number of application instances is within the budget limit K. The experimental results indicate that KEAD-P algorithm can significantly reduce service deployment time while maintaining high-quality service benefits compared to the BEAD-o algorithm, thereby enhancing the efficiency of service deployment.

articleTitle: MMCS: A Code Summarization Approach Based on Multi-Modal Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In the process of program development and maintenance, with the continuous upgrading and iteration of the program, the code structure becomes more and more complex, and the code comments are frequently out-of-date, inconsistent, or completely missing, which significantly lowers the productivity of software development and maintenance by requiring developers to spend a lot of time understanding the code. Therefore, many studies have tried to introduce deep learning techniques into automatic code summarization, all of which have achieved good results, but there are still some shortcomings that need to be improved, e.g., some studies directly input Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) sequences into the encoder, which results in insufficient structural information extraction; some studies perform graph embedding of ASTs or directly extract the control-flow graph of the code for graph embedding, which can only extract the AST's local structural information, and the semantic information extraction is insufficient. In this paper, we address the above problems and propose a code summarization approach MMCS based on multi-modal feature enhancement. MMCS firstly introduces four types of extended edges to transform AST, then designs multi-modal encoder, multi-modal fusion module, and finally generates the summarization by using the Transformer decoder. MMCS is conducted on Java and dataset and Python dataset with four baseline comparison experiments. The experimental results show that MMCS outperforms CODE-NN, Tree2Seq, Hybrid-DeepCom and MMTrans baselines on BLEU-4, METEOR and ROUGE, and MMCS improves 0.63%, 0.69% and 0.51 % on three evaluation metrics, respectively, compared to MMTrans.

articleTitle: SG-DDPM: Semantic-Guided Diffusion Model for Low-Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Recent advancements in low-light image enhancement (LLIE) through deep learning have been significant. However, these methods often struggle with effectively handling noise in dark regions, hindering the recovery of high-quality texture details obscured by noise. Moreover, existing approaches typically treat the entire image as a uniform entity, neglecting the semantic nuances of distinct regions. This oversight may cause a network to deviate from an area's original color without semantic priors. In response to these challenges, we introduce the Semantic-Guided Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (SG-DDPM). Leveraging a diffusion model for LLIE, our approach employs a sequence of denoising refinement processes to restore realistic details in dark areas. We have optimized the inference process of the diffusion model to enhance its speed. Additionally, we integrate the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract semantic information from low-light images, guiding the diffusion model through conditional guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that SG-DDPM exhibits competitive performance across three image enhancement datasets, showcasing improvements in quantitative metrics and visual quality.

articleTitle: Formation Prediction of MCA Intracranial Aneurysms Based on Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Aneurysms are asymptomatic local lesions that carry a risk of inducing subarachnoid hemorrhage once formed. Given the limited characteristic data available for studying aneurysm formation, constructing precise predictive models for intervention in potential conditions is challenging, making effective methods for predicting aneurysm formation crucial. In this study, we introduce an integrated predictive model that synergizes deep learning and machine learning to forecast aneurysm formation. The model is informed by a dataset of 144 aneurysm cases, each subjected to physician screening and manual virtual resection of aneurysms. This ensemble model employs a point cloud feature extraction model to derive deep vascular features post-virtual resection, which are then utilized to train machine learning models for predicting aneurysm formation. Throughout the experimentation phase, we developed five distinct machine learning models. The Support Vector Machine (SVM) model, in particular, demonstrated superior performance upon the integration of deep features, achieving an AUC of 0.94, with an accuracy rate of 91%, a sensitivity of 0.96, and a specificity of 0.84, outperforming machine learning models without deep features. Our findings indicate that spatially distributed morphological and hemodynamic features extracted via the point cloud feature extraction model significantly enhance the predictive capability of the model concerning aneurysm formation.

articleTitle: An Optimal Fusion Marker-Based Watershed Segmentation Method For Bubble Metering
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In the industrial flotation process, visual characteristics of the foam, such as its size and quantity, are key indicators for assessing and adjusting the flotation state. Thus, accurate segmentation of foam images to extract this statistical information is particularly crucial. However, effective segmentation of foam images remains a challenge due to the variability in foam characteristics caused by different raw ore properties and operational conditions. Despite numerous image segmentation methods proposed by researchers, difficulties such as high-lit areas in the images, adhesion between foams, and image noise are still challenging to overcome. In view of this, this paper presents a flotation foam image segmentation method based on optimal fusion marking. This method combines a block sub-graph classification model with boundary constraints and introduces optimal fusion marking to achieve more precise segmentation of foam images. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of this method are verified through a series of experiments.

articleTitle: Traffic Light and Zebra Crossing Detection Algorithm Based on Bagging Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The detection of traffic lights and zebra crossings holds significant importance for autonomous driving and ensuring pedestrian safety. Aiming at this issue, a Bagging ensemble learning-based algorithm is proposed in for the detection. The present study establishes a comprehensive dataset comprising traffic lights and zebra crossings, encompassing diverse traffic scenarios such as sunny, cloudy, rainy, and evening. Multiple bootstrap samplings are performed on the training set to obtain multiple sampling sets with different variances and used to train multiple weak learners. The trained weak learners are evaluated on the corresponding out-of-bag datasets, and the detection precisions are taken as their characteristic parameters. The detection results of the weak learners on the test set are integrated, and the reservation or rejection of the detection results is determined according to the respective characteristic parameters and the confidence scores assigned to the boxes. Experimental results show that the ensemble algorithm proposed in this paper can significantly improve the performance of the weak learner and effectively identify traffic lights and zebra crossings.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Virtual Simulation Game for Garbage Classification Empowered by Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper mainly faces the children group, revolves the science popularization garbage classification knowledge this topic, through the introduction and study of waste classification knowledge, 3D scene practice of waste classification and simulation practice of waste recycling, children can learn the knowledge of waste classification in the game, recognize the kind of garbage and the correct understanding of the kind of garbage, to the most authentic experience of garbage classification and garbage recycling.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Recommendation Algorithm Combined with PersonalRank Sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the problem of model cold start, the recommendation system was introduced into the knowledge graph., but it is difficult to obtain accurately user's preference because of strong noise in the expansion of knowledge graph. To solve this problem, a recommendation algorithm which combines the PersonalRank algorithm and knowledge graph was proposed. First of all, the entities generated from the knowledge graph were sampled by the PersonalRank algorithm, selecting areas that were more important to the target node. Then it was necessary to select the aggregator to aggregate features. Finally, the user features and item features were input into the prediction function to forecast the probability of user clicking items, thus reducing the influence of noise on the experimental results and improving the accuracy of the recommendation. Experiments were carried out on MovieLens-1M and Book-Crossing, and the AUC, ACC, Precision and Recall indexes were used to evaluate. The results show that PersonalRank algorithm can improve the performance of model recommendation.

articleTitle: Occluded Face Recognition Algorithm Incorporating Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Face recognition technology is widely used in various industries with its high recognition rate and the market size is growing. However, the problem of face recognition with occlusion has not been completely solved, and how to solve the problem of low accuracy of face recognition under real scene occlusion is still one of the hotspots in today's research. FaceNet face recognition algorithm is widely used in industry because of its fast operation speed, and its network structure can be flexibly improved for different situations. Therefore, this paper proposes an occluded face recognition algorithm incorporating the attention mechanism, which improves the network structure by combining the attention mechanism on the basis of the original FaceNet network. Firstly, the original backbone network is replaced with a MobileNetV3 network with its own Squeeze-and-Excitation channel attention mechanism, so that the network focuses on the unobstructed face region. Then, the attention mechanism is further improved. The original SE attention mechanism is changed to a coordinate attention (CA) mechanism that can embed location information in the channel attention to further enhance the more important feature information. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm achieves good results, with an accuracy of 99.61% on the LFW face dataset, and the accuracy on the LFW_Mask masked face dataset is also significantly improved, which can achieve accurate recognition of masked faces.

articleTitle: Contactless Height Measurement for Infants and Toddlers Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Height is one of the important indicators to evaluate the growth and healthy development of infants and young children, at present, the height measurement of infants and young children at home and abroad is still generally used in the soft ruler or horizontal measuring bed, etc., this traditional measurement method is not only inefficient, but also has a variety of drawbacks.
