To this end, the system takes the neural network Open Pose as the core, combines image processing, C# and HBuilder, and designs and implements a set of non-contact infant height measurement system based on computer vision technology, which can quickly and accurately measure the height of infants and young children, and has the advantages of non-contact, health and safetyIt can provide parents and doctors with reliable data on the growth and development of infants and young children.

articleTitle: TensoRF-GAN: Improving 3D-Aware Portrait Image Synthesis with Tensor Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Existing methods for synthesizing portraits with 3D-aware can produce remarkable high-quality portrait images while maintaining strong 3D consistency. However, the localized receptive field of the implicit function in NeRF poses a challenge for the generator to effectively encode the overall global structure of the feature field. Simultaneously, NeRF relies on volume rendering, which can incur high computational costs for generating high-resolution results, thereby intensifying the challenges in the training process. To address these challenges, we introduce TensoRF-GAN, a novel framework for efficient and high-quality 3D-aware portrait synthesis. Specifically, we integrate the high-quality and 3D view-consistent image synthesis method VolumeGAN with the Vector-Matrix (VM) decomposition technique and effectively optimize the 3D feature volume into factorized low-rank tensor components. From the experiments, our method not only demonstrates enhanced efficiency in terms of both training time and reduced GPU memory usage but also improves the image quality for the 3D-aware image synthesis.

articleTitle: Attention Information Fusion Emotion Analysis Model Based on BiLSTM-BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that most sentiment analysis methods do not focus on the weight fusion of local context and global context information and the important information in fusion features is not prominent, AIFM-BB (Attention information fusion emotion analysis model based on BiLSTM-BERT) is proposed. The model uses a pre-trained BERT model to process text vectors and a collaborative speech analysis algorithm to process audio vectors, and introduces BiLSTM and Attention mechanisms. The weight of the feature vector is dynamically adjusted by combining the global information and local information of text and audio and the attention information of text and audio modes. The emotion analysis results are obtained through the Softmax layer after the fusion features are self-focused. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed AIFM-BB model on the CMU-MOSI dataset is 85.3%, which is 2.8 percentage points higher than the baseline. In the multi-category emotion classification task, the accuracy of the model is 44.7%, an improvement of 1.1 percentage points compared with baseline. The accuracy is 83.6% on the CMU-MOSEI dataset, an improvement of 1.4 percentage points compared to baseline.

articleTitle: Content-Based Galaxy Image Retrieval Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The morphology of galaxies can reflect their own physical information and evolutionary processes. However, with the continuous improvement and application of astronomical observation equipment, the number of galaxy images has also grown exponentially. Therefore, accurately retrieving specific images from a large dataset of galaxy images is a challenging task. Using content-based image retrieval and deep learning in galaxy images can easily retrieve similar images, aiding astronomers in their analysis. In this paper, we propose a method based on ResNet-50 for accurate galaxy image retrieval. First, we preprocessed data from the Galaxy Zoo project and categorized it into six classes. Then, we conducted a set of comparative experiments, training the ResNet-50 model using both cross-entropy loss function and triplet loss function. Experimental results show that the ResNet-50 model trained with the triplet loss function performed the best. The model achieved a mAP of 0.9366 and mAP@5 of 0.9538, which enable accurate retrieval of specific galaxy images.

articleTitle: Many-Objective Optimization Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Dynamic Region Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Multi objective optimization evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) play a crucial role in addressing multi-objective optimization problems (MOPs) in the field of artificial intelligence. However, MOEAs often struggle to simultaneously maintain good convergence and diversity in Many-objective optimization problems (MaOPs). To address this problem, this paper proposes a Many-objective optimization evolutionary algorithm based on dynamic region partitioning approach (MaOEA-DRP). After non-dominated sorting, the solutions are initially uniformly partitioned into regions based on Euclidean distance. Within each region, at most one solution closest to the ideal point is selected. Subsequently, dynamic region partitioning is applied to the remaining individuals. In each iteration, a solution closest to the ideal point is chosen within the obtained region until the population size is satisfied. Experimental results indicate that MaOEA-DRP outperforms other algorithms significantly in terms of performance on the test problems.

articleTitle: Rice Pest Recognition Method Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Rapid and accurate identification of rice pests is a prerequisite for the control of rice pests. Due to the problem of miss-detection and misdetection of small targets in rice pests, this paper constructs the rice pest dataset RiPest and proposes an improved YOLOv8 algorithm Gi-YOLOv8. Firstly, the GAM attention mechanism is added to the YOLOv8 backbone network to preserve the correlation between spatial and channel information to improve the attention to small targets, and secondly, the BiFPN network is fused in the Neck part to achieve weighted fusion and bi-directional cross-scalar connectivity, which improves the model detection capability. Experiments show that the Gi- YOLOv8 model has an accuracy of 92.5% in the self-made RiPest rice pest dataset in this paper, which is a 1.3% improvement compared to before the improvement, and the recall and mAP50 are improved by 0.6% and 0.2%, respectively. The experimental results show that the Gi-YOLOv8 model can enhance the detection of small-target rice pests and provide an effective decision support tool for rice pest control.

articleTitle: Visual Alignment Estimation Algorithm of Robotic Arm Based on Key Point Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of intelligent robot technology, more and more fields have begun to introduce robots for operation. In the power industry, the live operation of substation switchgear has always been a high-risk and high-skill job. In order to ensure the safety of operators and improve the operation efficiency, it is of great significance to develop a live-line operation robot for substation switchgear. Among them, the visual alignment of the robotic arm is particularly important as the first link of the live-operated robot in the substation switchgear, which is a necessary condition to ensure the accuracy of the subsequent tasks. Visual alignment of robotic arm refers to accurately moving the end effector of robotic arm to the target direction through visual sensors. In order to simplify the alignment process and improve the alignment accuracy of the robotic arm, an end-to-end monocular vision robotic arm alignment network is proposed in this paper. The network model first generates the key point heat map of the key panel, and then obtains the alignment posture of the robotic arm through the regression of the key point heat map. Taking the key operation panel as an example, an experiment is carried out on the live-line operation robot of substation switchgear. The experimental results show that the robotic arm is light in weight and high in accuracy, which meets the actual operation requirements.

articleTitle: PancakeFS: A Write Efficiently and Read Optimized Filesystem
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the development of emerging technologies such as cloud computing and large AI models (such as LLM), many applications have placed higher demands on the intensive read and write processing of massive data. Addressing the limitations of traditional file systems, we propose PancakeFS, an LSM-Tree-based file system. Leveraging the write-friendly characteristics of LSM-Tree, PancakeFS exhibits efficient write performance. We improve read performance through the design of an inode allocation algorithm based on subtree partitioning and optimization of the disk layout for hot data reconstruction. Our experimental results demonstrate that PancakeFS outperforms Ext4 and TableFS in terms of both read and write performance.

articleTitle: Transfer Kernel Sparse Coding Based on Dynamic Distribution Alignment for Image Representation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Sparse coding based domain adaptation methods aim to learn a robust transfer classifier by utilizing the knowledge from source domain and the learned new representation of both domains. Most existing works have achieved remarkable results in solving linear domain shift problems, but have poor performance in nonlinear domain shift problems. In this paper, we propose a Transfer kernel sparse coding based on dynamic distribution alignment (TKSC-DDA) approach for cross-domain visual recognition, which incorporates dynamic distributed alignment into kernel sparse coding to learn discriminative and robust sparse representations. Extensive experiment on visual transfer learning tasks demonstrate that our proposed method can significantly out-perform serval state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Object Detection Methods Based on Multimodal Information Fusion in Digital Forensics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, electronic evidence, relying on computers and networks, plays an increasingly significant role in proving case facts. In the past, the identification of electronic evidence mainly relied on manual efforts, which was not only time-consuming and labor-intensive but also prone to errors and difficult to adapt to new situations. To address these issues, an increasing number of scholars have applied deep learning technologies to the field of electronic evidence identification and screening. Based on research in deep learning, this paper proposes a target detection method based on multimodal information fusion and applies it to digital forensics. By conducting image target detection and recognition in different densely populated areas, the results show that the improved model increases the average precision of target detection by 6.1% compared to the Faster RCNN model.

articleTitle: Video Sky Replacement Based on Dual-Branch Segmentation Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This article presents a video sky replacement technology. The core method of this technology is a semantic detail dual-branch sky segmentation network. It accurately extracts the sky area in the video using advanced segmentation technology. Subsequently, feature points in the sky area are extracted to calculate optical flow, enabling the tracking and identification of dynamic elements in the sky. By adjusting the image filter parameters, the color and brightness of the composite image can be accurately adjusted to seamlessly blend the replaced sky with the original video. This technology simplifies the video post-production process and provides creators with efficient tools to transform the world with just one click. It opens up new possibilities for enhancing visual effects and creative expression.

articleTitle: StackFi: An Ensemble Learning-Based Model for WiFi Sensing Classification Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The widespread adoption of WiFi devices and ubiquitous WiFi networks has fostered the development of the WiFi sensing domain. With the continuous progress in deep learning, a rising prevalence is observed in the application of deep learning techniques to the field of WiFi sensing. However, researchers often face the dilemma of choosing either convolutional neural networks, disregarding the temporal nature of Channel State Information data, or recurrent neural networks, overlooking the similarity between its subcarriers and the multiple channels in image data. We propose an ensemble learning-based model, StackFi, which combines two prevailing approaches in deep learning for processing Channel State Information (CSI) data. One approach analogizes CSI data to images, utilizing deep convolutional neural networks for feature extraction. The other treats CSI data as temporal data, employing recurrent neural networks for feature extraction. Our model extracts features from CSI data in WiFi signals, and these extracted features are then fed into a classifier. We gathered some commonly employed deep learning models in the field of WiFi sensing and contrasted them with StackFi using the public datasets UT-HAR and NTU-Fi HAR. Our model exhibited outstanding performance, achieving accuracy rates of 99.13% and 99.27% on these two public datasets, surpassing the performance of other models in the field.

articleTitle: Recognition of Tobacco Yellowing Degree in Curing Process Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to identify the Browning degree of tobacco leaves in the curing process, image acquisition equipment was installed in the curing houses of 11 tobacco producing areas in China, and the image data of tobacco leaves in curing process were obtained. The improved lightweight model EfficientNet-GECA is used for training and testing, the ordinary convolution in the MBConv module is replaced by the Ghost module, and the ECA attention mechanism is used to replace the SE attention mechanism, which reduces the amount of parameters and calculation of the model and improves the running speed. The recognition accuracy of the improved model in the test set reaches 88.74%, which is 1.61 percentage points higher than that before improvement. Compared with VGG16, ResNet50 and other models, the accuracy is increased by 9.76<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>and 5.27<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>respectively. The number of model parameters is 2.97M, which is only 56.14%and 11.62%of EfficientNet and ResNet-50, and the recognition speed of a single image is only 16.86ms. The improved EfficientNet-GECA model can recognize the Browning degree of tobacco in the baking process, which provides important support for the development of intelligent tobacco baking.

articleTitle: Data Transfer Optimization Scheme Based on dSpace High-Fidelity LiDAR Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Validating intelligent algorithms within the realm of Autonomous driving Domain Controllers (ADC) using virtual simulation platforms has become a foundational industry paradigm. Modeling the perception system of autonomous driving on a simulation platform, especially sensor modeling, has become a crucial aspect for validating intelligent algorithms. To accurately simulate real sensors, it is imperative to construct sensor models reasonably and ensure accurate data transmission between the sensor model and the ADC. This paper, based on the high-fidelity dSpace simulation platform, employs a LiDAR model to simulate a real LiDAR within the perception system. Post-processing operations, such as time synchronization and data validation, are applied to the LiDAR model to ensure the accuracy of the sensor model's data link. Addressing issues of mismatched data transmission frequencies and inconsistent data packet quantities between the LiDAR model and the ADC, we propose a solution named DCD-FIFO based on a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) queue. In this solution, the LiDAR model actively manages frame dropping, complements missing data packets, and delays sending data packets to the ADC to resolve data transmission issues. Experimental results demonstrate that the high-fidelity LiDAR simulation model in the dSpace platform accurately simulate a real LiDAR. Moreover, using the proposed DCD-FIFO solution, reliable data transmission is achieved between the LiDAR model and the ADC.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Distribution Path Optimization Method Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This research introduces a method for optimal route planning in port logistics distribution, utilizing an enhanced ant colony algorithm. The method takes into account the distribution limitations in real-world surroundings and constructs a systematic model with the objective of minimizing the overall length of planned routes. Building upon the conventional ant colony algorithm, it extensively explores feasible delivery paths by enhancing the ant's selection method for the subsequent target node and reusing suboptimal solutions. Additionally, it decreases the disparity in pheromone concentration between the optimal and suboptimal solutions within the solution space, thereby augmenting the algorithm's likelihood of escaping local optima. To compare the proposed algorithm with existing ones, multiple target nodes are randomly generated and utilized as simulation environments. The test results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm not only effectively plans logistics distribution routes, but also delivers shorter overall paths and possesses a stronger capability to seek global optimal solutions.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Multi-Step Prediction of Railway Freight Volume Based on Informer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Accurate prediction of freight volume data is directly related to the preparation of railway transport plans. This paper proposes the Informer model to predict freight volume at major stations of railway network. First, the freight volume data is transformed by temporal embedding, which considers whether the day is in the skylight maintenance period, to better explore the time characteristics. Next, the decoder structure containing the ProbSparse self-attention mechanism is applied to capture the long-term correlation from the embedded data. Finally, the decoder structure is used to generate forecast information at once. Using the freight volume data of China Energy Investment, the high-precision railway freight volume prediction of twelve loading stations in the next 14 days is achieved. Experiments show that Informer model exhibits better prediction performance with the growth of the sequence: the RMSE value is improved by 90/0-27.4% over LSTM, GRU, LSTM with Self-Attention and Transformer.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Person Re-Identification Based on Multi-Scale Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This study presents IBN-MSAN, an innovative unsupervised domain adaptation framework designed to improve person re-identification (ReID) in computer vision. IBN-MSAN utilizes an enhanced version of ResNet50, combining instance and batch normalization with a new attention mechanism for more effective feature extraction. This approach merges convolutional attention modules and multi-scale attention networks, leading to better feature and attention focus. This enhancement is crucial for identifying essential visual elements and critical image regions. The research employs a pseudo-label retraining method to adapt to different domains. This involves training the model with labeled data from the source domain, then using clustering algorithms to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled target domain data, and fine-tuning the model accordingly. This strategy notably increases the model's capability to manage occlusions and complex backgrounds, improving both the efficiency and effectiveness of unsupervised training with the incorporation of multi-scale attention mechanisms.

articleTitle: Research on Fusion Optimization of Multi-Provincial College Entrance Examination Volunteer Filling Algorithms Based on Stacking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The voluntary application of college entrance examination is an important support for the orderly enrollment of college students and the smooth admission of candidates. After the new college entrance examination reform, it is emphasized that candidates' selected subjects must match the requirements of professional enrollment subjects proposed by colleges and universities, and the logic of filling in the college entrance examination volunteers has changed significantly compared with that before the reform, especially the college entrance examination reform is promoted in five batches, and the ways of filling in the volunteers in various provinces are inconsistent, which puts forward new requirements for the algorithm optimization of the college entrance examination consulting system and the voluntary filling software system. In order to effectively improve the broad accuracy and effectiveness of college entrance examination voluntary filling algorithms in the context of the new college entrance examination, this paper, based on the algorithm and in combination with various matching needs of the new college entrance examination reform, attempts to optimize, uniformly improve and integrate the recommended algorithms of college entrance examination voluntary filling in provinces. The algorithm has achieved good prediction effect in the real data test of a province and a city, and the data analysis results are obviously better than other existing algorithms. The relevant algorithm can provide some reference for the follow-up study of voluntary filling and guidance in the provinces of college entrance examination reform.

articleTitle: Using the XGB-LCE Model for Cardiovascular Disease Prediction From Individual Pivotal Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease stands as a primary global cause of mortality. Utilizing individual pivotal factors for cardiovascular disease prediction can compensate for the limitations of physiologically-based predictions. This approach not only reduces medical costs but also facilitates more precise intervention in disease progression. Moreover, existing cardiovascular disease prediction methods suffer from limitations such as challenging feature handling, inaccurate predictions, and inadequate treatment of imbalanced data. Thus, we introduce an XGB-LCE model for cardiovascular disease prediction from individual pivotal factors. Firstly, this paper employs XGBoost to identify the optimal subset of features and study their contribution to predictive outcomes. Next, the optimal feature set is input into the LCE model for prediction and compared against other models. Experimental results demonstrate that the LCE model achieves an accuracy of 94.1%, an AUROC of 97.1%, and an AUPR of 98.4%.

articleTitle: Safe Advantage Actor-Critic Based on a Pool of Dangerous Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Reinforcement learning requires agents to interact extensively with the environment, engaging in thorough exploration during the learning process. However, in practical applications, random exploration of the environment often entails significant risks. Taking dangerous actions could potentially lead to catastrophic consequences. Hence, reinforcing safety in reinforcement learning is an essential aspect for its practical implementation. This paper proposes enhancing the Advantage Actor Critic algorithm by introducing a deep Q-network, referred to as the punisher. The Punisher network learns from a pool of dangerous samples and provides a penalty factor to the Actor network. This allows the Actor network to learn while considering both reward and penalty factors. It penalizes actions that might lead to dangerous states, thereby strengthening the traditional Actor Critic framework with safety measures.Finally, within the Gym platform's Mountain Car game, this method demonstrates the ability to enhance safety during exploration while sacrificing a certain degree of learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power Consumption Wetland Environment Monitoring System Based on Lora Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In view of the problems of large wetland environmental monitoring area, complex environment and long communication distance, a wetland environmental monitoring system based on LoRa networking communication is studied and designed in this paper. The system is composed of environmental information collection node, gateway node, cloud server and client. The environmental information collection node sends data to the gateway node through LoRa communication technology, and the gateway node sends the data to the cloud server through the 5G module after data processing to realize the remote monitoring and management of wetland environment. In order to solve the problem of packet loss rate in traditional LoRa networking, a LoRa communication mode based on CSMA/CA enhancement is proposed. The experimental results show that the functions of the system are relatively stable, the LoRa wireless effective communication distance between the environmental collection node and the gateway node is about 25500m, the node power consumption is low, and the mobile power supply can be used to meet the long-term monitoring needs, providing a technical basis and reference for large-scale wetland environmental monitoring and management.

articleTitle: DLinear-Based Prediction of the RUL of PEMFC
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) has attracted more and more attention due to its advantages of low pollution and high energy density. Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is one of the most promising electric energy sources for electric vehicles. The prediction of remaining useful life (RUL) is the main problem to promote the wide application of PEMFC. Currently, DLinear has shown promising results in RUL prediction. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved RUL algorithm based on DLinear, DLinear builds on the linear layer to extract trends and seasonal features in the series by performing a moving average on each column of the time series. However, input sequences are often multidimensional, and this method does not consider the temporal dependencies among the overall features at different time points. To address the limitations of DLinear in feature extraction, our method utilizes an attention mechanism to capture dependencies among different time points in the time series. Additionally, as the output after the attention mechanism undergoes a non-linear transformation, there is a risk of losing information related to the original time series trends and seasonality. To mitigate this, we introduce residual connections, allowing the network to learn inherent trends and seasonal components from the input time series. The introduction of residual connections safeguards the intrinsic trend and seasonal components in the original time series. Experimental validation of our proposed model using real operational data from vehicles demonstrates its high precision.

articleTitle: A Missing Data Imputation Method for Electricity Consumption Data Based on TCN-Attention with Mask Tokens
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the popularization of smart meters, power companies can collect massive amounts of data from users for non-invasive load detection, electricity theft detection, etc. However, due to faults in smart meters and abnormal communication, the dataset often has missing values, making it difficult for data-driven methods to be widely applied. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised learning method based on TCN-Attention to fill in customers' electricity consumption data. Firstly, we extract electricity consumption features through TCN. In order to improve the feature extraction capability, we introduce a channel attention mechanism to TCN. The attention mechanism makes TCN focus on the effective features in the data by assigning weights. Meanwhile, we use mask tokens to cover a certain proportion of data, forcing the proposed model to learn potential feature representations of the data during the training process. Finally, the features are restored to data through feedforward neural networks. An example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Method for Constructing a Dictation System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology and a Dictation Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: At present, the learning machine on the market is seriously homogenized, and there is no machine for detecting the sequence of Chinese stroke writing. Most fonts are simply animated strokes, and students still cannot learn Chinese characters or English words without parents or teachers' checks and prompts. In order to make up the blank of Chinese character writing and improve students' learning efficiency, this paper discusses a method of automatic detection based on artificial intelligence. This article designs a method for constructing a dictation system based on artificial intelligence technology and a dictation machine. Through artificial intelligence technology, a comprehensive Chinese and English word dictation system is constructed, with simple cutting and multi word or multi word photo recognition function. At the same time, a stroke order algorithm has been designed to identify whether the stroke order is correct. The database is comprehensive and stores the words that have been dictated, making it convenient for the next review call. It can meet the needs of self-learning, dictation, and pen sequence correction, and has broad market prospects.

articleTitle: Multi-Behavior Recommendation Based on Heterogeneous Graph and Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: User interactions with items in recommender systems are sequentially correlated, and heterogeneous. Studying the dependencies between multiple behaviors can improve recommendation accuracy. Our study presents a new model that efficiently models fine-grained dependencies between multiple behavioural categories. It also obtains a better representation of item embeddings using sequential temporal information through the time-aware multi-behavioural embedding module. The decoupled self-attention module is used to incorporate auxiliary information of items and improve recommendation performance without affecting the embedded semantic information. We compared the HR and NDCG performance metrics with other baseline models on the Tmall and RetailRocket datasets and achieved better performance than all baseline models. In addition, we validate the effectiveness of our individual modules through ablation experiments.

articleTitle: Identification of Schizophrenia and Depression Based on Deep Learning and EEG
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Schizophrenia (SCH) and depression (DEP) may be misdiagnosed, mainly because their symptoms have certain similarities and are susceptible to emotional changes. In this study, a deep learning model (CEEGA-Net) based on convolutional neural network (CNN), gated circulation unit (GRU) and attention mechanism (AM) is proposed to classify EEG signals from SCH and DEP to improve the diagnostic accuracy of patients with these two types of diseases. In this paper, a deep learning model that can automatically extract and classify important features was adopted. Data from Peking University Sixth Hospital, a total of 154 participants. The experimental paradigm was auditory oddball task. The local features are extracted by convolutional neural networks, then the features are sequentially modeled and weighted by the GRU layer and the attention mechanism, and finally the fully connected layer is used for classification. Our CEEGA-Net model has an average accuracy of 98.3% for trial-based classification and 85.1% for subject-based classification under the ten-fold cross-validation method. The results of the study show that CEEGA-Net can distinguish SCH and DEP well under this experimental paradigm, and the high accuracy and reliability of the model may help doctors to distinguish these two diseases more accurately in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Signal Enhancement and Dimensionality Reduction by XDAWN and Compressive Sensing Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: A brain-computer interface (BCI) is a communication system that allows the brain to control external devices. In this paper, we propose a method based on the XDA WN and compressive sensing (CS) models to enhance the performance of online BCI. The method aims to generate features for signal enhancement and dimensionality reduction of motion-onset visual evoked potentials (MVEP). The experimental results of data analysis demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Offloading Algorithm Based on Mobile Edge Computing Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The paper models the interaction process between users and edge cloud based on the Stackelberg game. Firstly, the users' cost is modeled as a minimization problem with the amount of offloaded tasks of each user as a constraint and the revenue of edge cloud is modeled as a maximization problem with the computation capacity of the edge cloud server as a constraint. Then, for the problem of minimizing users' cost, the paper derives the optimal offloading scheme under uniform pricing which follows the threshold strategy and gives the users' bandwidth allocation strategy. Finally, for the problem of maximizing the revenue of edge cloud, the paper substitutes the optimal offloading plan, and finds the optimal price. The paper compares the proposed distributed offloading algorithm with optimized bandwidth allocation with the fully local computing algorithm and the bandwidth sharing algorithm. The average user latency has been reduced by more than 30% and 20%, and the revenue of edge cloud has increased by more than 1.5 times.

articleTitle: Steel Surface Defect Detection Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high misdetection and leakage rates in steel surface defect detection, we propose an improved algorithm based on YOLOv7. The algorithm introduces Swin- Transformer's sliding window encoder into the YOLOv7 structure to capture the contextual information and global dependencies of steel surface defects at different scales, so as to fully learn the semantic features of the target. Meanwhile, we utilize the ACmix attention module to improve the network's attention to small targets, which effectively solves the problem of the original model's omission detection of small targets. Finally, the lightweight convolutional technique GSConv is used in the feature fusion part of the model to reduce the computational complexity of the model. The experimental results show that on the NEU-DET dataset, the detection accuracy of the algorithm reaches 78.5%, which is 4.00/0 higher than the original YOLOv7 algorithm. Compared with the traditional algorithm for detecting steel surface defects, this algorithm has higher detection accuracy and detection rate, which can play an important role in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based RF Fingerprint Identification using Cyclic Shift Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Radio frequency fingerprint (RFF) is a promising technique to address Internet of Things (IoT) terminal authentications. We propose a novel RFF extraction method for signals with cyclic shift characteristics (CSC). During the preprocessing stage, a preamble spectrum correlation and signal tracking (PSCST) algorithm is proposed to compensate for carrier frequency offset. The robust RFF is extracted from the method based on cross power spectral density (CPSD), which utilizes all symbols within a frame. A convolutional neural network (CNN) is designed to recognize different devices using the CSC features. Compared to existing CNN-based RFF identification methods, the proposed CSC-CNN possesses the merits of data independency, channel interference resistance, and high communication efficiency, particularly in long-distance and low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions. The accuracy rate of CSC-CNN algorithm is higher than 98.42% in indoor/outdoor LOS scenario and 98.35% in NLOS scenario with a higher SNR. In a dynamic scenario where the terminal moves slowly in a circular path around the receiver, the highest accuracy attained through cross-time validation is 98.16%, which outperforms existing RFF identification methods when classifying 60 target LoRa devices.

articleTitle: Progress in Artificial Intelligence Applications Based on the Combination of Self-Driven Sensors and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In the era of the Internet of Things, developing a smart sensor system with sustainable power supply, easy deployment, and flexible use has become a challenging problem. Traditional power supplies, prone to frequent replacements or requiring charging during usage, hinder the advancement of wearable devices. The contact-to-separate friction nanogenerator (TEN G), composed of polychotomy ethylene (PTFE) and aluminum (AI) foils, addresses this issue by harvesting human motion energy through body movement arrangement. This energy is then utilized to monitor human motion posture by detecting changes in output electrical signals. In 2012, Academician Wang Zhonglin and his team invented the triboelectric nanogenerator (TENG), which operates as a self-driven sensor primarily powered by Maxwell displacement current. This enables direct conversion of mechanical stimulation into electrical signals during action, making it suitable for self-powered sensor applications. TENG-based sensors boast a simple structure and high instantaneous power density, providing a crucial tool for constructing intelligent sensor systems. Additionally, when combined with machine learning characteristics such as low cost, short development cycles, robust data processing, and predictive capabilities, the processing of the numerous electrical signals generated by TENG has a significant impact. The integration of TENG sensors is poised to drive the rapid evolution of intelligent sensor networks in various fields such as transportation, security, water conservancy, and construction, where urban sound management is essential. The method of seamlessly integrating sensors with Internet access is implemented using the NetBox network development platform, following these steps: 1) Initially, read the default parameter settings from pre-existing storage media, including parameters like IP address, subnet code, gateway address, sensor input and output types, and sensor range. These settings can be modified online to match the specific sensor used.2)Convert the sensor output signal into digital format using analog-to-digital conversion within the microcontroller.3)The microcontroller receives tasks from either the sensor or the Internet, such as medium, display, data processing, and web server, and processes them according to specified priorities. Existing sensor networks often comprise costly information sensing devices, limiting their large-scale deployment and functional measurement range due to cost and maintenance constraints.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Risk Assessment Model Based on NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In the field of computer artificial intelligence, traditional data analysis methods face challenges of incomplete data and low processing efficiency. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel risk assessment model based on Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology. Utilizing deep learning, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, the model analyzes unstructured data such as text, social media information, and news reports, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of data processing. The research results show that, compared to traditional methods, this model has significant advantages in data processing efficiency and accuracy. Future research will focus on enhancing the adaptability and practicality of the model, providing a more effective risk assessment tool for the field of computer artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Using Graph Isomorphism Network to Solve Graph Coloring Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The graph coloring problem is a classical NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem, which aims to assign distinct colors to connected nodes as much as possible. Currently, graph neural networks are being applied to combinatorial optimization problems but have not yielded satisfactory experimental results. This paper discusses the advantages and challenges of different types of graph neural networks in solving the graph coloring problem. It is deduced that graph isomorphism networks possess stronger coloring abilities than other types of graph neural networks in theory, leading to a graph isomorphism network model based on physical-inspired framework and tabu search algorithm to solve the graph coloring problem. The theoretical findings have been empirically validated, demonstrating that the proposed model performs comparably or superiorly to existing solvers in terms of both quality and running time.

articleTitle: Physical Adversarial Attacks for Infrared Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Utilizing the physical adversarial methods to attack infrared objects is on the rise. However, existing physical infrared attacks are complex to implement in real world due to professional and cumbersome making processes. And these attack methods only target infrared pedestrian objects. In this work, we propose an alternative physical method to attack infrared pedestrian and infrared car objects, named Sensitive Region Patches, with low-cost and easy making process. Given that the imaging mechanism of infrared imager by capturing the thermal radiation of the obj ect, Sensitive Region Patches perform attacks by attaching the aerogel patch, a thermal insulation material to the Sensitive Region (SR) of the object to alter its thermal distribution. Therefore, we propose a consensus selection strategy to find out the Sensitive Region (SR), and cover such SR in the obj ect with the aerogel patch cropped based on SR to achieve the physical attack. We conduct experimental measurements both in infrared car detection and infrared pedestrian detection to verify our Sensitive Region Patches. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves over 70% Attack Success Rate (ASR) under various physical conditions, including shooting angles, distances, postures, and scenes, and Sensitive Region Patches can be constructed physically in just 0.25 hours, demonstrating the effectiveness and simplicity of our method.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Pulverized Coal Loading Image Based on Improved SOLOv2
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low efficiency of instance segmentation algorithm for pulverized coal image segmentation and inability to avoid background interference, this paper proposes a pulverized coal instance segmentation algorithm based on improved SOLOv2. The innovation of this method is to combine the MobileNetv2 lightweight network structure with the high-resolution feature pyramid network as the backbone extraction network to extract the features of pulverized coal images at each resolution, which ensures the high resolution of the feature map and reduces the number of parameters; and the introduction of spatial and channel reconstruction convolutions reduces the amount of feature redundancy and at the same time enhances the feature representation capability. Tests are conducted on the pulverized coal test set, and the results show that compared with the original SOLOv2 model, the model reduces the detection time and the number of parameters by 14.8% and 13.112 M, respectively, while guaranteeing the accuracy. The improved SOLOv2 model enhances the detection efficiency and has better robustness, which is suitable for industrial production.

articleTitle: A Persistent Naming Discrimination Method Based on the Sweeping Direction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: So far, China's high-end industrial field in industrial software design, research and development is still a blank. To fill the blank, the project called “Wukong” has been carried out by ZWSOFT company. One of the requirements of high-end industrial design software is strong modeling stability. The problem of persistent naming of topological elements is a basic problem to be solved in the current parametric system. In view of academic research and commercial parametric modeling software, there is still ambiguity and instability in the persistent naming of symmetric topological elements. In order to improve the modeling stability and reduce the ambiguity of persistent naming, a persistent naming discrimination method based on the sweeping direction is proposed. The method has both conceptual rigor and theoretical rigor. It has been applied to Wukong. Experiments show that the proposed method is more stable than UG and CATIA in modeling scenarios with symmetric split faces. Therefore, it is believed that the parametric modeling stability can be improved by this method.

articleTitle: A New Method of Motion Planning for Mobile Robots Based on Improved JPS and Polynomial Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, the mobile robots get a wide range of applications. Path planning algorithms play an extremely crucial role when mobile robots autonomously navigate in complex environments. The current path planning algorithms for complex grid maps have problems, such as low efficiency and unsmooth paths. In order to solve those problems, this paper proposes the fusion of multi-segment polynomials for jump point search algorithm, which realizes the construction of collision-free and path-smooth trajectories on complex raster maps. First of all, the heuristic function of the jump point search has been improved by adding weight factors, distance factors, and directional factors. Secondly, a line-of-sight method has employed to prune the path point set, which optimizes the drawback of excessive node exploration of traditional jump point search algorithm. Lastly, the multi-segment polynomial method is used to smooth the trajectory, which aims to improve the drawbacks of traditional path planning algorithms where the trajectories are not smooth. What's more, this study adopts a closed-form solution for the multi-segment polynomial to enhance the overall convergence speed of the algorithm. The experimental results presented in this paper demonstrate that our algorithm outperforms the Theta and A* algorithms in terms of memory consumption by 97% and 15.7%. In comparison to JPS and A*, improved JPS demonstrates improvements of 73% and 97%, in terms of node count. Furthermore, in comparison to JPS and A*, improved JPS demonstrates increases of 86% and 97%, in terms of total path angular change. In terms of time efficiency, our approach shows an enhancement of 8%, 12%, 15.9%, and 25% when compared to JPS, Theta, A*, and BOA algorithms. Additionally, our method indicates an increment in total path length by 7.3%, 33.5%, 36.3%, and 33% compared to JPS, Theta, A*, and BOA.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Manageability Reversible Data Hiding Based on the Encrytion Process of Shamir's Secret Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to achieve hierarchical management of ciphertext access in cloud space, this paper proposes a hierarchical reversible data hiding technique in the encrypted domain based on the construction redundancy of Shamir's secret sharing. Firstly, different chaotic sequences are allocated as hiding keys to protect secret information at various levels. Then, the sharing key is distributed according to the hierarchical relationship to ensure controllable data access at different levels. During the process of secret sharing encryption based on Lagrange interpolation polynomials, we directly control polynomial construction parameters to enable reversible data hiding while carrying out threshold sharing with disaster tolerance. By further implementing sharing encryption on the obtained ciphertext shadow, users from different layers can be linked for access. Storing the ciphertext in a distributed manner enhances information security of the cloud space since no valid information can be obtained from a single ciphertext shadow. Additionally, our scheme exhibits strong disaster recovery performance due to its retention of secret sharing's threshold feature for lossless recovery and accurate extraction. Simulation experiments verify that when setting [2], [3] as the threshold for the first layer and [2], [2] and [2], [3] as thresholds for second layer shared shadows respectively, our scheme achieves a significant embedding capacity of 4 bpp while extending ciphertext size to 6.

Author Keywords: Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted Domain

articleTitle: Research on Optimisation Strategies of Energy Saving Train Operation Control
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This study is dedicated to solving the complex interchanging patterns adopted by urban rail transit trains in China due to the complexity of passenger flow characteristics, with special focus on the optimisation of urban rail transit train schedules. Through an in-depth study of the operational data under the large and small crossing modes, this paper proposes an effective train schedule optimisation proposal based on the primary and secondary objective planning, using the hierarchical sequence method and the weighting method, and taking the time cost as the core consideration. The study uses cross-section passenger flow diagrams to determine the alternative set, introduces the primary and secondary objective planning and hierarchical sequence method, and constructs a dual-objective nonlinear mixed-integer planning model with the primary objective of satisfying passenger flow demand, combined with the secondary objectives of enterprise operation cost and service level. Through the MATLAB programme solution, the optimal train operation scheme was derived, including the operation interval of small interchanges, and the number of large and small interchanges. Through sensitivity analysis, the study found that the passenger flow has little influence on the selection of the starting and ending points of the minor interchanges, indicating that the model has good robustness. This study provides a practical optimisation scheme to alleviate urban traffic pressure.

articleTitle: Prediction of Negative Emotions from Online-Offline Handwriting Features
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Negative emotions can adversely affect our health, relationships and productivity. Research into the detection of negative emotions can enable people to better understand and cope with these harms, and help them to better manage and regulate their emotional states. With the rise of soft biometrics and the digital transformation of businesses, how to use electronic handwritten information for emotion detection has become a concern for researchers. In this context, we propose the first Chinese handwritten negative emotion database that links emotional states with handwriting. The database contains a total of 3,100 samples from 20 participants, records multiple tasks using digitised tablets and emotion scales, and stores two types of handwriting features, online and offline. We then designed a complete feature extraction and selection process to realise the extraction and fusion of online and offline features. Finally, we used k-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Random Forest and Adaboost to construct classifiers associated with negative emotional states. We provide metrics to evaluate the accuracy, sensitivity and specificity obtained from cross-validation experiments. The experimental results show that the method achieves good results compared to existing machine learning methods, with an average accuracy above 92%.

articleTitle: Research on Job Scheduling Optimization for Automated Dual-Station Stacker Cranes in Stereoscopic Warehouses
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: To address the inefficiencies in the job scheduling of stacker cranes and to enhance system throughput, this paper constructs an optimization model aimed at minimizing the total travel distance of the stacker crane, in light of the storage and retrieval characteristics of dual-station stacker cranes. An improved Ant Colony Algorithm (ACA) with enhanced initial pheromone concentration, pheromone update strategy, and transition rules is designed to solve the model. A simulation analysis is conducted using a real-world case of a shelf storage and retrieval task in Company Y's hardware warehouse, and the results are compared against random access strategy, first-come, first-served strategy, and the nearest neighbor strategy. The findings indicate that the improved ACA yields paths that are 20.5%, 17.9%, and 14.6% shorter than those obtained from the aforementioned strategies, respectively. The experimental results validate that the enhanced ACA effectively optimizes the path of dual-station stacker cranes, thereby improving the storage and retrieval efficiency in stereoscopic warehouses.

articleTitle: EffiPoseNet: Integrating Ghost Modules and CoordAttention for Efficient Real-Time Human Pose Estimation on Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the popularization of mobile devices in daily life, the increasing demand for real-time human pose estimation applications puts forward higher requirements for computational efficiency and accuracy of models. Although existing attitude estimation models perform well in standard benchmarks, their deployment on mobile devices has been greatly challenged, especially due to the large number of model parameters and the large amount of computation. In this paper, we present EffiPoseNet, a lightweight human pose estimation network tailored for mobile devices, which combines the Ghost module and the CoordAttention mechanism to significantly reduce the computational burden and improve model performance. By introducing GhostCAneck module and using sparse feature maps and derived feature maps generated by Ghost module, the parameters and computational complexity of the model are effectively reduced. Besides, we designed the GhostCAblock module, which incorporates the coordinate attention mechanism to enable the model to focus on key areas in the image more precisely. Our extensive experimental evaluation of EffiPoseN et on the COCO dataset shows that EffiPoseNet remains competitive with advanced models on key performance metrics such as average accuracy (AP), with significant reductions in the number of parameters and calculated operands. EffiPoseN et demonstrates the possibility of achieving efficient and accurate human pose estimation on resource-constrained mobile devices.
